# Master Services Agreement

## Section 1. Scope of Services

Vendor will provide the professional services described in one or more
Statements of Work ("SOWs") executed by the parties. Each SOW is
governed by this Agreement.

## Section 2. Fees and Invoicing

Customer will pay Vendor the fees set forth in each SOW. Vendor will
invoice monthly in arrears unless otherwise specified.

## § 3. Intellectual Property

Pre-existing intellectual property of each party remains its own.
Vendor assigns to Customer all rights in deliverables created
specifically under an SOW, subject to the licenses described in the
applicable SOW.

## Clause 4. Confidentiality

Each party will maintain the confidentiality of the other party's
non-public information using at least the same care it uses for its
own.

## Part V. Warranties

Vendor warrants that services will be performed in a professional and
workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.

## (6) Limitation of Liability

Neither party will be liable for indirect damages. Aggregate liability
is capped at fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim.

## 7. Termination

Either party may terminate for convenience with thirty (30) days'
notice, or for cause upon material breach uncured for thirty (30) days
after written notice.

## 8.1 Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of
Massachusetts.
